atoms.text: Broccoli is a green vegetable. The roots are rather small compared to the flowering head of the plant. The largest part of the broccoli plant grows above the ground.
Carrots are also healthy vegetables. The orange part of the plant grows underground, and is the part which people usually eat.

text: This picture shows a Venn diagram. The middle part tells you what is similar about two things. The outside parts tell you what is different about the two things.

instruction.text: Compare and contrast carrots and broccoli by filling out the Venn diagram.

atoms.sound: Both carrots and broccoli are vegetables.
The orange part of the carrot grows underground.
The flowering head of the plant grows above ground.
